task1.packing: CLS A SEP B SEP, segment0 through first SEP and1 through final SEP; global continuous positions; right PAD excluded by valid_len.
task1.mlm: Candidates valid non-special tokens, including exclusion of pre-existing UNK; K=min(C,max(1,round(.15*C))) for C>0, drop C=0. Python round semantics. Without-replacement positions; 80%MASK/10%ordinary random/10%unchanged. Original labels retained. Random ordinary replacement may equal original. Padded prediction slots weight0.
task1.nsp: Keep publisher split, restore top-level article documents before splitting paragraphs on ' . '. Positive adjacent sentence same paragraph/doc. Negative same split different document; reject normalized text equal A or true successor. Empty candidate pools/overlength examples counted rather than silently relabeled. Textbook is_next1/not_next0.

task2.data: Real publisher nonraw WikiText2 named Parquet release; NOT claimed original ZIP byte equivalence. Small vocabulary fit selected train only.

task3.load: Exact D2L weights+paired60005 vocab+code-derived config. Safe restricted loading then strict state keys/shapes. No random-weight fallback and no tokenizer swap.
task3.snli: Publisher train/validation plain_text. Exclude -1; HF0/1/2->textbook0/2/1. Premise entails hypothesis. Use split,row index,text hash because parquet omits pairID/parse.
task3.head: Transfer encoder and Linear+Tanh pooler, new H->3 head; unused MLM/NSP heads excluded from NLI optimizer. CLS is sequence position0, special tokenID3.
task3.truncate: Reserve3 boundaries, remove longer side tail, tie remove hypothesis, max_len <=512, record truncation.
